comparison.objective: Candidate depins a connector; record fits a gasket between flanges and installs four bolts.
comparison.physical_skill: Single-blade latch release and coupled extraction versus deformable-part registration around obstacles followed by repeated bolt insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Selected terminal exits without damage or neighbor release versus gasket flat and centered, all four bolts installed, assembly still, and grippers clear.
comparison.reason: Insertion is only a generic primitive; the record tests gasket placement and multi-fastener assembly.
